title.en: Partner commission on a booked appointment (phone)

intro.sr: Partner ima dve odvojene stope provizije - jednu za usluge, drugu za proizvode. Kad klijent zakaže termin preko partnerovog koda za preporuku, provizija se obračunava po stopi za usluge, nikad po stopi za proizvode, čak i kad su podešene na potpuno različite vrednosti. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: A partner has two separate commission rates - one for services, one for products. When a customer books an appointment through a partner's referral code, commission is calculated using the services rate, never the products rate, even when they're set to very different values. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
